# Kyoto Family Trip Overview: 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-20

A relaxed 3-day Kyoto plan for **2 adults + 1 child** with a **45,000 JPY sightseeing budget** excluding hotel. It balances temples, easy food stops, one rainy-day backup, and modest transit costs.

# 3-Day Kyoto Family Plan

## Day 1: Higashiyama Classics + Gion Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Kiyomizu-dera, then a slow walk through Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka.
- **Afternoon:** Lunch near Gion, then Yasaka Shrine and Maruyama Park for an easy break.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Lunch near Gion, then Yasaka Shrine and Maruyama Park for an easy break, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening:** Gion stroll for atmosphere; keep it short and child-friendly.
- **Food:** Yudofu or a simple set meal near Kiyomizu/Gion.
- **Transit estimate:** **1,200 JPY** total for buses/taxis combined if you avoid long walks.

## Day 2: Arashiyama Nature + Temple Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Arashiyama Bamboo Grove early, then Tenryu-ji garden.
- **Afternoon:** River area and Togetsukyo Bridge; optional short train ride or snack stop.
- **Evening:** Return to central Kyoto for a calm dinner.
- **Food:** Tofu dishes or soba in Arashiyama.
- **Transit estimate:** **2,400 JPY** total using train + bus for 3 people.

## Day 3: Fushimi Inari + Central Kyoto Market Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- **Morning:** Fushimi Inari Taisha; do only the lower section to keep it relaxed.
- **Afternoon:** Nishiki Market for snacks, souvenirs, and a light lunch.
Media: Alt=Afternoon:** Nishiki Market for snacks, souvenirs, and a light lunch, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening:** Optional Kamo River walk or early wrap-up near downtown.
- **Food:** Tamagoyaki, mochi, pickles, and small bites at Nishiki Market.
- **Transit estimate:** **1,800 JPY** total for train/bus transfers.

## Budget Breakdown for 3 People

| Category | Estimated Cost | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Temple/shrine entry | 2,500 JPY | Kiyomizu-dera + Tenryu-ji or similar paid spots |
| Food & snacks | 24,000 JPY | Family meals, sweets, market snacks |
| Local transit | 5,400 JPY | Mix of buses, trains, and occasional taxi |
| Rainy-day backup entry | 3,500 JPY | Museum or indoor attraction if needed |
| Small reserve | 9,600 JPY | Extra snacks, drinks, minor flexibility |
| Total | **45,000 JPY** | Excluding hotel |

## Rainy-Day Backup: Kyoto Railway Museum or Kyoto Aquarium

If weather turns wet, swap in one of these:
- **Kyoto Railway Museum** for an easy indoor family day with interactive exhibits.
- **Kyoto Aquarium** for a lighter pace and child-friendly indoor time.
- Keep the same lunch/transport plan and skip the longest walking segment that day.

## Pace and Family Fit

- Each day stays at **3 major activities or fewer**.
- The plan keeps walking clustered by area to reduce transit fatigue.
- Temple visits are paired with parks, markets, or food stops so the child has regular breaks.
Media: Alt=Temple visits are paired with parks, markets, or food stops so the child has regular breaks, Kyoto, Japan
- If energy runs low, the easiest place to shorten is the evening stroll on Day 1 or the optional extra time in Arashiyama.
